MEET THE DOCTOR
Dr. Elena Marchetti

PRINCIPAL DENTIST · AESTHETIC & RESTORATIVE

Elena founded Lumière on a simple conviction: dentistry at its best should be quiet, unhurried and almost invisible in its results. She trained in restorative dentistry in Milan and completed her prosthodontics master’s in London, where she has practised for the last fourteen years.

Her work centres on minimally invasive aesthetics — preserving natural enamel wherever possible, and treating every case as a facial design problem rather than a set of individual teeth.

QUESTIONS
Answered before you ask
How do I know which treatment I actually need?

Start with a comprehensive exam. We assess your teeth, gums, bite and facial proportions, then send you a written plan with staged options and costs. Nothing is booked or charged beyond the consultation until you have had time to read it.

What happens at the first appointment?

A full clinical examination, digital radiographs, intraoral photographs and — for cosmetic cases — a 3D scan. You will leave with a clear diagnosis and a printed treatment roadmap. It takes about forty-five minutes and there is no obligation to proceed.

Do you treat nervous or phobic patients?

Routinely. We offer longer appointment slots, stop-signal agreements, topical anaesthetic before every injection, noise-cancelling headphones and both oral and intravenous sedation with a dedicated sedationist. Tell us when you book and we will plan around it.

Can I spread the cost of treatment?

Yes. Courses over £500 can be split across 6, 12 or 24 months, and we offer an interest-free option over ten months. Finance is arranged at the practice once your plan is agreed — never before.

How long do veneers and bonding actually last?

Hand-layered porcelain veneers typically last fifteen to twenty years with good maintenance. Composite bonding lasts five to eight years and can be polished or patched rather than replaced. Both depend heavily on grinding habits, so we screen for that first.

What is your cancellation policy?

Reschedule or cancel free of charge up to forty-eight hours before your slot. Inside forty-eight hours we ask for 50% of the reserved chair time, because a two-hour appointment cannot usually be re-filled at short notice.

Do you accept dental insurance?

We are an independent private practice and can provide itemised invoices with treatment codes for any insurer. Most patients with Bupa, AXA or Vitality policies claim the majority of restorative work back directly.

What should I do in a dental emergency?

Call the emergency line at any hour. For a knocked-out adult tooth, hold it by the crown, rinse it in milk, place it back in the socket if you can, and get to us within the hour — reimplantation success drops sharply after sixty minutes.
